role: Campus Admin, CCE (and every role that reaches it)
cur: The page renders the error boundary "This page hit a problem" on first load for all 7 roles. Console: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'length'). Browser tests do not cover this route.
exp: The page shows the course/term filters and the cohort table (or an empty-state), and lets a campus admin record attendance, enrol a cohort and condone ineligible candidates.
why: `useGet(null)` (api.ts:36-41) returns loading=false, data=null while the course list is still loading; `Async` (ui.tsx:77) then calls children(null) and `Table` reads null.length (enrolment/page.tsx:12-13). The route error boundary catches it, so the page never recovers without "Try again".
impact: The only UI for attendance entry, bulk enrolment and eligibility condonation is unusable. "Enrolment & eligibility" (Campus Admin) and "Eligibility" (CCE) are primary navigation items. Students and invigilators who guess the URL see "This page hit a problem" instead of a permission message.
repro: Sign in as admin.a → click "Enrolment & eligibility" (or open /enrolment). Observe the error card; console shows the TypeError. Same for cce, super.admin, examiner, lecturer.a, student, invigilator.
fix: Treat a null path as "not requested" (return loading=true or an `idle` state), make `Async` render nothing/skeleton for data===null, and guard `Table` rows with `rows ?? []`. Add a permission gate so roles without `enrollment.read` see "You do not have access" rather than an error boundary. Add a Playwright spec that opens /enrolment as Campus Admin.
acc: Opening /enrolment as admin.a renders the filters and a table or "No enrolments…" with zero console errors; as student it shows a permission message; new spec passes.
ver: Observed in browser (7 roles); root cause traced in source.

role: Super Admin (data effect visible to all)
cur: Clicking Deactivate on DNC-C (affiliation AFFILIATED) changed the stored affiliation to CONSTITUENT. Reproduced through the API: PATCH {active:false} → affiliation reset; a city-only PATCH also resets it. The row then shows status "Cancelled".
exp: Toggling the active flag changes only `active`. An inactive institution is labelled "Inactive", not "Cancelled".
why: The update DTO inherits the create schema's default for `affiliation` (org.controller.ts:9), so any partial update silently rewrites the field. The page sends only {active} (institutions/page.tsx:15) and the UI shows no sign that another field changed.
impact: A routine UI action corrupts the constituent/affiliated hierarchy, which drives campus scoping and reporting. Nobody is told.
repro: API: GET /institutions (note DNC-C affiliation) → PATCH /institutions/:id {"active":false} → GET again. UI: Institutions → Deactivate on DNC-C → Affiliation column changes.
fix: Make the update schema a true partial (no defaults) and add a regression test: PATCH {active:false} leaves every other column unchanged. Replace the "CANCELLED" status token for inactive institutions with "Inactive".
acc: PATCH with a single field changes only that field (API test); UI label reads "Inactive".
ver: Reproduced twice (UI and API) on a disposable database.

cur: When a save request never completes (hung connection, captive portal, black-holed packets) the per-question indicator stays on "Saving…" indefinitely (observed 30 s, no change, no banner, no escalation). The request helper has no timeout (api.ts:10 accepts a signal but none is supplied).
exp: After a short bounded wait (e.g. 8–10 s) the indicator changes to "Not saved — retrying" and a visible banner appears, exactly as for offline/500.
why: Only the browser `offline` event and non-2xx responses trigger the "not saved" state. A request that neither fails nor succeeds is indistinguishable from "in progress" forever.
impact: A candidate on a bad network believes the answer is being stored while it may not be; they can leave the question and the final submit then blocks (UI-004). Trust in the one signal students rely on is weakened.
repro: Student a025: open the 100-question paper, intercept PUT /api/attempts/*/answers/* so it never responds, choose an option, wait 30 s.
fix: Give every save an AbortController timeout (~10 s), treat a timeout as a failed attempt with backoff, and surface the page-level "answers not stored" banner when any answer is unsaved for more than N seconds.
acc: With a never-responding save endpoint the indicator changes from "Saving…" within 12 s and a banner shows the unsaved count; Playwright test with route.hang().
ver: Observed in browser at 5 time points.

cur: With one failing save, "Review & submit" disables itself, shows only a thin "Checking that every answer is stored…" bar for ~20 s (flushAll(20000)), then a message "1 answer(s) could not be stored yet… Do not close this window." The candidate cannot open the review screen, cannot see which question is unsaved, and has no "review anyway" option. "Save & next" blocks for 8 s the same way.
exp: The review screen opens immediately, lists the unsaved question(s) with a "Retry now" action, and only the final Submit step is gated.
why: Review is treated as a precondition-check instead of a read-only view; progress feedback is a 12-px status line.
impact: In the last minutes of an exam on a poor network the student loses ≥ 20 s per attempt and cannot find the problem answer. Time pressure + silent blocking is the exact situation this screen must handle best.
repro: Student a029: intercept PUT answers with HTTP 500; choose an option; click "Review & submit"; poll for 28 s.
fix: Open the review screen immediately; show per-question sync state in the palette (e.g. a "!" badge) and a "Retry unsaved answers" button; gate only the final "Confirm and submit".
acc: With failing saves the review screen opens in < 1 s and lists unsaved questions; submit confirm explains the count.
ver: Observed in browser (HTTP 500 and hang modes).

cur: The palette is a 296 × 674 px block that is neither sticky nor independently scrollable. Fully visible palette buttons on first screen: 90/100 at 1536×864, 72 at 1366×768, 66 at 1280×720 and 1024×700, 0 at ≤ 960 px (moved to a sheet). The page itself scrolls to reach the rest, taking the question out of view.
exp: All question numbers remain reachable without moving the question: palette column sticky with its own scroll (or compact grid) on desktop.
why: Layout is a two-column grid whose right column simply grows with the number of questions.
impact: On typical laptop screens a student with a 100-item paper must scroll the page to reach questions 67–100 and loses sight of the current question and answer options while doing so.
repro: Student a010/a018/a019: enter the 100-question paper at 1366×768 / 1280×720; count palette buttons fully inside the viewport (script measures them).
fix: Make the aside `position: sticky; top: <header height>; max-height: calc(100vh - header); overflow:auto`; add "Go to question #" input and a "next unanswered" button for ≥ 50 questions.
acc: At 1280×720 every palette button is reachable without scrolling the page; Playwright measures the sticky aside.
ver: Measured in browser at 6 viewport sizes.

cur: The Campus Administrator menu has no "Live monitor" item. /monitor and /monitor/:id render fully for that role, and "Upcoming exams" on the dashboard does not link to it. Reference deck page 23 and the campus-admin task "find a student during an active exam" both depend on it.
exp: "Live monitor" is in the Campus Administration menu (and surfaced on the dashboard while an exam at their campus is live).
why: nav.ts defines CAMPUS_ADMIN without the monitor entry while the permission exists.
impact: The most time-critical exam-day tool is discoverable only by typing a URL.
repro: Sign in as admin.a → inspect sidebar (9 items, no monitor) → open /monitor directly: it works.
fix: Add { href:"/monitor", label:"Live exams" } to CAMPUS_ADMIN and a "Live now" tile with a link on their dashboard.
acc: Campus admin sidebar contains the monitor link and active state highlights it on /monitor/:id.

cur: For an exam that is already LIVE the card says "Opens 01 Nov 2026 13:27" (a past time) and its only action is "Go to schedule"; the schedule then needs "Start →", and the exam page needs "Begin examination →". Three live exams exist but the card shows one. "Upcoming exams: 3" counts exams that are live.
exp: A live exam is labelled "Live now — closes 08 Nov 13:32" with a "Start exam" button that goes straight to the instructions; multiple live exams are listed.
why: The dashboard card renders `d.next.opensAt` unconditionally (dashboard/page.tsx:32) and has no concept of availability.
impact: The first screen a student sees on exam day gives a wrong time and an indirect action. Students will ask "has it started?".
repro: Sign in as student.a004 with the seeded live exam: read the card; click through to start (3 clicks).
fix: Return `availableNow` and `closesAt` from the API; render "Live now" + direct Start link; list all live exams.
acc: With a live exam the dashboard shows "Live now" and the Start button reaches /exam/:id in one click.

cur: Three exams show Status "Live" with an enabled "Start →" button AND "Starts in 00:58:34" (a countdown to the planned window). A published exam shows "Starts in 00:58:34" with a locked button. The countdown column ignores manual start/close.
exp: Status, availability and timing agree: Live → "Closes in …"; Published/closed → "—".
why: `Countdown to={r.opensAt}` is shown whenever there is no attempt (schedule/page.tsx:29) regardless of status.
impact: Contradictory signals on the one screen students use to decide whether they may start; erodes trust in MANUAL-control exams.
fix: Compute the column from status: SCHEDULED → "Starts in", LIVE → "Closes in"/"Open", others "—".
acc: No row combines status Live with "Starts in"; unit test over the status matrix.

cur: No skip link on any of 197 audited loads; the first Tab stop on 176 pages is the first sidebar link ("Dashboard"), followed by 6–10 more nav links before the page content.
exp: A "Skip to main content" link is the first focusable element and the main landmark has an id target.
impact: Keyboard and switch users traverse the whole menu on every page.
repro: Load any page, press Tab once; run the crawl data (`tabStops`).
fix: Add a visually hidden-until-focus link to #main (the main element already has id="main").
acc: First Tab stop is "Skip to main content" and Enter moves focus to main.

cur: Every page (197/197 authenticated loads and all public pages) has the title "SZABMU Online Examination System".
exp: Titles describe the page: "Question bank — SZABMU OES", "Control centre · Audit — 100-question Pathology Paper".
why: A single static `metadata` export (app/layout.tsx:7); no per-route metadata.
impact: Tabs, history and screen-reader page announcements are indistinguishable; invigilators with several windows cannot tell them apart.
fix: Add route-level `generateMetadata` or a client `useDocumentTitle` hook from PageHead.
acc: Distinct titles on all routes (automated check).

cur: axe reports "serious" colour-contrast failures on 154 pages (570 nodes): #8A7A77 on white = 4.09:1 and on ivory = 3.83:1 (needs 4.5:1 at these 9–12 px sizes). Affected: breadcrumb (every page), stat tile labels, hints, "Opens", empty-state text, timestamps.
exp: All text ≥ 4.5:1.
why: One token (`--ink-3`) is used for small text that should use `--ink-2` (7.9:1).
impact: Low-vision users cannot read breadcrumbs and secondary labels; small print on already small text.
repro: axe-core on any page; computed ratios in doc 16.
fix: Darken --ink-3 to ≈ #6E5F5C (≥ 4.6:1 on ivory) or move text to --ink-2.
acc: axe color-contrast: 0 violations on all routes.

cur: The 100 palette buttons are `<button role="listitem">`, which removes their button role for assistive technology; each is a separate Tab stop (86 Tab presses from Q1 to Q87; no roving tabindex or arrow-key movement).
exp: A grouped set of real buttons (or a listbox with roving tabindex) with a "go to question" shortcut.
why: Role override at page.tsx:218; no keyboard model for the grid.
impact: Screen-reader users hear list items, not controls; keyboard users cannot reach a distant question efficiently.
repro: Inspect DOM; press Tab from the first palette button until Question 87 is focused (86 presses measured).
fix: Remove role="listitem"; wrap in nav/list semantics; add arrow-key roving tabindex and a numeric jump field.
acc: Palette buttons expose role=button; Q87 reachable in ≤ 5 key presses.

cur: Opening any dialog leaves keyboard focus on the trigger behind the overlay (`focusInside:false` on the submit dialog); no focus trap and no focus return. Escape closes (good).
exp: Focus moves to the dialog title/first field, is trapped, and returns to the trigger on close.
why: ui.tsx Modal adds only an Escape listener.
impact: Keyboard users can Tab into the page behind a "modal" dialog, including in the high-stakes submit confirmation.
repro: Player → Review & submit → Submit examination… → read document.activeElement.
fix: Autofocus the dialog heading, trap Tab, restore focus on close.
acc: Automated focus test passes for every modal.

cur: In an achromatopsia (greyscale) emulation "Unanswered" (maroon border) and "Not visited" (rose border) are nearly identical, "Skipped" is only a pale fill, and the legend is colour swatches. Aria-labels do carry the state for screen readers.
exp: Each state has a non-colour cue (icon/pattern/text letter).
impact: Colour-blind students cannot tell what still needs attention.
repro: Chrome DevTools → Rendering → Emulate vision deficiency: achromatopsia; look at the palette.
fix: Add glyphs (✓, –, !, ⚑) to palette buttons and legend.
acc: All five states distinguishable in greyscale.
ver: Manually verified with emulation (partial: no user study).

cur: "Clear response" removes a saved answer with one click, no confirmation, no undo, and sits in the same row as Skip and Mark for review.
exp: Undo toast ("Answer cleared — Undo") or confirmation when clearing a saved answer.
impact: A mis-tap on a phone erases an answer; the student must notice and re-choose.
repro: Choose an option → click Clear response → no dialog (dialogShown 0).
fix: Add undo toast for 8 s; move Clear to a secondary position.
acc: Clearing shows undo; undo restores and re-saves the answer.

cur: Four similar controls: "Skip question", "Save & next →", "Next →", palette. Answers autosave, yet the primary button says "Save & next" (blocks 8 s while saving). "Next" without answering marks the question "unanswered" while "Skip" marks it "skipped" – the review screen then reports Skipped / Unanswered / Not visited as three separate counts.
exp: Two navigation actions (Previous/Next) plus an optional Mark; "Skipped" and "Unanswered" are merged ("Not answered").
why: Distinct engine states leak into the UI.
impact: Students must learn a vocabulary during the exam; "Save" implies manual saving is required.
repro: Q1 answer → Next → Next → Skip → inspect palette aria-labels: answered / unanswered / skipped.
fix: Rename to "Next →" (primary) and drop "Save &"; merge states in UI copy; keep Skip only if policy requires.
acc: Review screen shows "Not answered (n)" and "Marked (n)" only.
ver: Observed in browser; design recommendation on the label.

cur: To reach Q87 on a phone: tap "Questions", swipe the sheet once (390×844) or twice (360×640), tap the number = 3–4 interactions; 54 of 100 buttons visible without scrolling at 390×844, 30 at 360×640. The sticky header uses 168 px (20% of 844, 26% of 640).
exp: A numeric "Go to question" field and a "Next unanswered" shortcut; header ≤ 15% of viewport.
why: Same grid reused in a sheet; header stacks logo/title/clock/buttons.
impact: Slower navigation under time pressure; less room for the question on small phones.
repro: Student a021/a022: open the sheet and measure scrollHeight vs clientHeight (script).
fix: Add jump-to input and next-unanswered; collapse header to one row (clock + Review).
acc: ≤ 2 interactions to any question; header ≤ 15% at 360×640.

role: Student, Lecturer, Examiner, Campus Admin, Invigilator, CCE, Super Admin
cur: Opening a page the role may not use gives three different results: a raw API panel under the full page chrome ("You do not have access to this — Your role is not permitted to perform this action") on /questions for students (page title and filters still shown), a dead-end line "This page is for candidates." with no heading on /schedule and /results for staff, and an unexplained crash card on /enrolment (UI-001). The staff view of /exam/:id is bare text with no navigation at all.
exp: One pattern: a 403 page naming the page and the roles that can use it, with a link home.
why: Pages fetch first and render errors; some check role in the component, some not.
impact: Users cannot tell "not permitted" from "broken".
fix: Central route guard from the permission map; one ForbiddenPage component.
acc: Every restricted route shows the same 403 page; no restricted page issues data requests (62 console 403s today).

cur: Examiner and Campus Admin see "+ Register institution" and per-row "Deactivate" and get a generic toast "Your role is not permitted to perform this action" (HTTP 403) after clicking; the examiner sees an enabled "Approve paper" for a paper they submitted and is refused with a toast ("four-eyes principle") even though a notice already says so.
exp: Controls the role cannot use are hidden, or disabled with the reason.
why: Visibility is not driven by `can()` on these pages.
impact: Trial-and-error, and the server-refused action looks like a bug.
fix: Gate by `can(...)`; disable with title for four-eyes.
acc: No 403 reachable from a visible enabled button for any role.

cur: "Live (push). Your campus only." is shown to university-wide roles viewing 78 candidates from two campuses; for an unassigned exam the page shows "Reconnecting — refreshing every 8 s" under a permanent "Exam not found" error and keeps polling a 404.
exp: Scope text matches the viewer ("All campuses (2)" / "DMC-A only"); an error stops the "reconnecting" message.
impact: A controller cannot trust which candidates the table represents.
repro: examiner → Live monitor → open exam; invigilator.a → /monitor/<unassigned id>.
fix: Derive scope text from `me.institutions`; stop polling on 404.
acc: Subtitle shows the actual scope.

cur: "Question review" → page "Question bank"; "Schedule & approve" (examiner) and "Papers & results" (CCE) both → page "Examinations"; "Eligibility" and "Enrolment & eligibility" → page with no title (crash). Breadcrumb on non-menu routes (/programs, /students for examiner, /certificate) is blank ("Student ›").
exp: Menu label = page title = breadcrumb.
why: Labels are per-role but page titles are shared.
impact: Users cannot confirm where they are.
repro: Compare the NAV table (doc 03) with each destination h1.
fix: Pass the role label into PageHead or rename the pages per role.
acc: Automated test: nav label equals h1 for every menu item.

role: Examiner, CCE, Lecturer, Invigilator, Campus Admin, Super Admin
comp: Routes reachable but not in the menu
cur: Reachable with real content and no menu entry: Students (examiner, CCE, invigilator), Institutions (5 roles), Programs & courses (all roles incl. students), Question bank (CCE, super admin), Exams list (invigilator), Live monitor (campus admin). Invigilators can read the full exam list including drafts.
exp: Each role sees exactly the pages it is meant to use; read-only reference pages are reachable from where they matter.
why: Menus and permissions are maintained separately.
impact: Hidden capabilities and unclear intent (is the invigilator meant to read draft papers?).
fix: Review each role's read permissions; add nav entries or remove access.
acc: Route matrix = menu matrix, reviewed by owner.

cur: Examiner: 4 tiles (all labels, no list). Invigilator: 3 tiles with no "Open live monitor" action. Campus admin: "Students 40 / Accounts 43 / Upcoming exams 3 / Open incidents 0" — "Upcoming" counts live exams, "Accounts" vs "Students" is ambiguous, nothing about attendance, eligibility or the live exam at their campus. Roughly 70% of each page is empty.
exp: Each dashboard answers "what needs me now?": pending approvals list, live exam with campus counts and a primary button.
why: Tiles were the only component built.
impact: Extra navigation for the most common first action.
fix: Add "Needs action" list and a role-specific primary action card.
acc: Each role reaches its top task in one click from the dashboard.

cur: "Staff & accounts" lists the 40 student accounts together with staff, each row carrying "Deactivate" and "Reset password" buttons, duplicating the Students page. The label says staff; the content is everyone.
exp: Staff accounts only (role filter default), students managed from Students; destructive actions confirmed.
impact: Risk of deactivating the wrong person; noisy.
fix: Default the role filter to staff; move student account actions to the student record.
acc: Default view lists staff only.

cur: Deactivate executes immediately (no dialog); the row flips to "Cancelled / Activate".
exp: Confirmation naming the consequences (users/exams affected) and the term "Inactive".
impact: One mis-click disables a campus.
fix: Use the existing Confirm component.
acc: Dialog with consequences before PATCH.

role: Lecturer, Examiner, Super Admin, Campus Admin
cur: "Create draft" (14 fields), "Save draft" (question) and "Register" are disabled until the form is valid, with no required markers (0 fields marked required), no inline messages and no hint about what is missing. Escape closes a modal and discards typed text without warning. The question modal is 769 px tall (scrolls on a 768 px laptop).
exp: Required markers, inline validation on blur, a summary of what is missing, unsaved-changes protection.
why: Validation is a boolean on the button.
impact: Users see a dead button.
repro: examiner → New examination; lecturer → New question; read button disabled state and labels.
fix: Add `required` + asterisks, field-level errors and a dirty-check on close.
acc: Every form shows what blocks submission.

cur: Building a paper means ticking checkboxes in an unfiltered list of all approved questions (110 rows, newest first): no search, no difficulty/topic filter, no select-all, no running total of questions/marks, no per-question marks. A 100-question paper is 100 clicks.
exp: Search/filter, bulk select by filter, marks column, live totals, drag ordering.
impact: Slow and error-prone for real papers.
fix: Add filters + "select all matching" + totals bar.
acc: 100-question paper built in < 10 interactions.

cur: Search text and filters are not in the URL and are lost on back navigation (search "Hira" → open dashboard → Back → empty search, 25 rows). The empty search result says "No students." without echoing the query or offering Clear. Pagination text works ("80 records / Page 1 of 4").
exp: Filters in the query string; empty state echoes the filter and offers reset.
impact: Users repeat searches after every detail visit.
repro: super.admin → Students → search → navigate away → Back.
fix: Sync filters with `useSearchParams`.
acc: Back restores filters.

cur: Row buttons read "+ Time", "End" and "Report" with no candidate in their accessible name (189 identical "Report" buttons on one page). "End" ends a candidate's attempt (force-submit) but is styled like a secondary action. The Report dialog is good: it names the candidate and asks for a 10-character description.
exp: "Add time", "End attempt…" (confirmation), "Report incident" with row-aware aria-labels.
impact: Screen-reader users hear the same button 78 times; "End" is easy to misread as "end session".
fix: Rename and add aria-labels with the registration number.
acc: No two controls on a page share an identical accessible name.

cur: The close-examination dialog's confirm button is labelled just "Close" and its dismiss ✕ has aria-label "Close": the dangerous action and the dismiss control share a name. "Close admission", "Close examination…" and the force-close checkbox are three different operations behind near-identical words; "Reconcile attempts" and "Initiate scoring" are system jargon.
exp: Distinct verbs: "Stop new entries", "End examination…", "Seal all attempts now"; confirm buttons repeat the exact action ("End examination").
impact: Wrong-button risk during a live exam.
repro: cce → control centre → open each dialog.
fix: Rename per doc 18; change dismiss aria-label to "Cancel and close dialog".
acc: Unique names; confirm button text equals action.

cur: Examiner and lecturer bells show 132 / 130 unread; the panel lists 100 (no pagination, no filter, only "Mark all read"). One example item for examiners ("Results ready for review") links to /results, a candidate-only page ("This page is for candidates."). Student links resolve correctly (/results, /schedule).
exp: Grouped/collapsed notifications, a visible total, working deep links per role.
why: One notification per event, no grouping; shared destination map.
impact: Real approvals are buried; the link dead-ends.
repro: examiner → bell → click "Results ready for review".
fix: Group by type; role-aware links.
acc: Bell total matches list; no link lands on a "for candidates" page.
ver: Observed in browser (volume caused by 110 fixture submissions).

cur: Entering "abc" as the phone number and pressing Save shows "Profile saved" and stores "abc" (checked in the database). The page also has two "Sign out" buttons (header and inside the password card).
exp: Format validation with an inline error; a single sign-out.
impact: Bad contact data accepted; duplicate control confuses.
fix: Add phone pattern to the DTO and form; remove the inner Sign out.
acc: "abc" rejected with message.

cur: When a list API never answers, three skeleton bars remain indefinitely (observed 20 s) with no "taking longer than usual" message or retry. HTTP 500 handling is good ("Something went wrong on our side" + Try again).
exp: After ~8 s show "Still loading…" with Retry.
why: No timeout in the request helper.
impact: Users cannot tell hung from slow.
fix: Same timeout as UI-003; slow-load message.
acc: A hung request surfaces a retry within 10 s.

cur: Student rows have no link, button or detail view: a campus admin can search a student (e.g. DMC-A-2024-0009) but cannot open their record, see attendance/eligibility, or confirm exam-day attendance. Combined with UI-001 the "locate a student and confirm attendance" journey cannot be completed.
exp: Student detail page with enrolments, eligibility, attempts and an exam-day attendance action.
impact: Primary campus task unsupported.
fix: Add /students/:id and attendance register (design first).
acc: Journey G completes in ≤ 4 steps.

cur: Menu: Dashboard, Question bank, Examinations, Students, My profile. No "My courses", no grading queue/manual grading, no course materials (reference pages 15, 17, 18). The dashboard shows "Students at campus 40" instead of assigned courses; "Examinations" lists every exam with copy "Build papers, approve, schedule, monitor and publish." that does not apply to a lecturer.
exp: Assigned courses first, with per-course question counts and review status.

acc: Lecturer sees assigned courses on first screen.

cur: The sticky header is 168 px high on 360–390 px phones (126 px on 768) and 76 px on desktop; at 640×360 (200% zoom) the Save/Skip/Next row is below the first screen.
exp: ≤ 56 px on phones.
impact: Little room for long vignettes; focus can sit under the header (WCAG 2.4.11).
fix: Single-row compact header.

cur: axe "critical" aria-allowed-attr: `<span class="chip" aria-pressed>` on the question-pipeline chips (dashboard, /questions): they look like filters but are not interactive.
exp: Real buttons that filter, or plain text.

fix: Make them links to filtered lists.

cur: Shows raw tokens: action "auth.login", role "campus_admin", entity "user ea48217f", empty Detail column, 7 columns including a hash. In the crawl screenshot the "When" cell wrapped to four lines (not reproduced in a later measurement).
exp: Human wording and linked entities; hash in a details drawer.

cur: All four public pages scroll sideways by ≈ 2 px at 360 and 390 px (scrollWidth 392). Every public page logs a 401 console error (GET /api/auth/me) on load.

cur: Reloading the exam page returns to the instructions page and requires "Resume" again.
exp: Reload resumes directly with a one-line notice.
impact: One extra click after a refresh.
fix: Auto-resume when an attempt is IN_PROGRESS.

cur: With a long vignette at 390×844 option A starts below the first screen (page height 2,278 px). The header and clock stay visible (good).

fix: Sticky bottom action bar.

exp: Both pages use the same definition.

cur: 101 tables: none has a caption; only 6 have header scope; 37 pages have an empty `<th>` (action column); the scrollable table wrapper is not keyboard-focusable on 2 pages.

cur: The bell's accessible name "Notifications, 5 unread" does not contain its visible text "Notifications 5" in order (axe label-content-name-mismatch on 105 pages).
exp: Accessible name starts with the visible label.
impact: Voice-control users.
fix: aria-label="Notifications 5".
acc: axe clear.

cur: 43 loads have no <h1> (student-only pages shown to staff, enrolment crash); the exam player has no <main> landmark (14 loads).
exp: One h1 and one main per page.
impact: Navigation by headings/landmarks.
fix: Wrap player in <main>.
acc: axe clear.

cur: 11 distinct border-radius values, 13 font sizes (10–30 px), 18 hard-coded hex colours in CSS outside tokens, 14 in TSX and 101 inline `style={{}}` blocks. Base font is a fixed 14 px (no rem), so browser text-size settings are ignored. Crimson is both the primary action colour and the danger colour.
exp: Token scale; rem-based type.
impact: Drift and accessibility (WCAG 1.4.4 potential).
fix: Consolidate tokens; rem font sizes.
acc: Token audit script passes.

cur: Input, select and option-card borders (#E9DDDA on white) are 1.33:1; WCAG asks 3:1 for the boundary of a UI component.
exp: ≥ 3:1 boundary or other visible affordance.
impact: Low-vision users cannot see field edges.
repro: Computed ratio (doc 16); not caught by axe.
fix: Use a darker border for inputs.
acc: Border ≥ 3:1.

cur: For an invalid or non-existent certificate the error card "We could not find that — Certificate not found" is shown beneath an active "Print certificate" button and a blank breadcrumb. Certificates exist only for passing results (a passed candidate got SZABMU/2026/1000).
exp: No print action on an error; explain that certificates are issued for passes.
impact: Minor.
fix: Hide Print in error state.
acc: Done.

cur: Columns "MIN", "QS", "CANDIDATES" abbreviate; "Opens" shows the planned window even for manual-control exams already live; no direct "Control centre" link in the list (needs Open › first); subtitle "Build papers, approve, schedule, monitor and publish." is shown to every role.
exp: Role-specific subtitle; status-aware "Opens".
impact: Small.
fix: Copy and column tweaks.
acc: Reviewed copy.

cur: No global search, no help/support or policy link, no institution/campus switcher (campus is only shown as plain text at the foot of the sidebar). The reference deck has a global search and messages icon.
exp: Search for exams/students/questions; help link; visible campus context in the top bar.
impact: Context is easy to miss for multi-campus users.
fix: Add after design decision.
acc: Campus visible in header for scoped roles.

comp: Empty state for an excluded candidate
cur: A student excluded for attendance below the threshold (DMC-A-2024-0001) sees "Upcoming exams 0" and "No examinations are scheduled for you yet." The exam URL says only "You are not registered for this examination. Back to schedule". Nothing states that eligibility was withdrawn, why, or whom to contact.
exp: "You are not eligible for Pathology Mid-term (attendance 62 % — minimum 75 %). Contact your campus administrator by <date>."
why: Ineligible candidates are simply left off the roster, so the UI has nothing to show.
impact: Students discover on exam day that they cannot sit and receive no explanation; support load falls on campus administrators.
repro: Sign in as student.a001 → dashboard, schedule, then open /exam/<id>.
fix: Return excluded exams with a reason code and show them as "Not eligible" rows.
acc: Excluded candidate sees the exam with reason and contact.

cur: With 5 very long options (≈ 520 characters each — an extreme fixture) each option card is 157 px tall at 1440 and 439 px at 390; the page is 2,843 px tall on a phone and Save & next is far below the first screen. Text wraps correctly with no clipping or horizontal overflow.
exp: Acceptable wrapping; consider a sticky bottom action bar so Next/Mark stay reachable.
impact: More scrolling for rare long-option items.
fix: Sticky bottom action bar on phones.
acc: Primary actions reachable without scrolling to the end of long options.
